cards.title: Today’s vocabulary
sections: just a moment · /ˌdʒʌst ə ˈmoʊmənt/ · fixed expression · Phrase · New
a polite request for someone to wait a short time. Just a moment. I need my pen.
take your time · /ˌteɪk jɚ ˈtaɪm/ · fixed expression · Phrase · New
used to tell someone that there is no need to hurry. Take your time. We can wait.
one more time · /ˌwʌn mɔr ˈtaɪm/ · fixed expression · Phrase · New
once again, used when asking for repetition. Please say your name one more time.
hold on a second · /ˌhoʊld ɑn ə ˈsɛkənd/ · fixed expression · Phrase · New
a casual request to wait very briefly. Hold on a second. My book is in my bag.
sixty seconds. Puck needs one minute.
Cover the words. Say three from memory. Make a new sentence with one, then check the example.

articulation.label: wait
articulation.alt: wait: /w/ → /eɪ/ → /t/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /w/: Round the lips; raise the back of the tongue.
/ɪ/: Raise the front tongue; narrow the jaw gap.
/t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.
articulation.note: Keep each vowel glide inside one syllable.
